title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with @qortex/query-react
content: Install @qortex/query-react using your preferred package manager. Note that @qortex/query-react includes all @qortex/query functionalities.

sections.title: Install Package
sections.content: Add the package to your React project:

code.code:
# npm
npm install @qortex/query-react

# yarn
yarn add @qortex/query-react

# pnpm
pnpm add @qortex/query-react
